item.title: MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane)
item.description:
What Is MSM?

Methylsulfonylmethane (MSM) is an organic sulfur compound found naturally in plants, animals, and humans. It provides bioavailable sulfur, the fourth most abundant mineral in the human body and an essential building block for numerous biological processes.

MSM occurs naturally in foods like vegetables, fruits, grains, and animal products, but in relatively small amounts. Supplemental MSM provides concentrated sulfur that supports joint health, reduces inflammation, and promotes healthy skin, hair, and nails. It has been used for decades as a natural approach to joint discomfort and inflammatory conditions.

item.title: Quercetin
item.description:
What Is Quercetin?

Quercetin is a polyphenolic flavonoid found abundantly in plant foods, particularly apples, red onions, green tea, berries, and cruciferous vegetables. It exists as a glucose conjugate (quercetin-4’-glucoside) in foods, which is cleaved by gut bacteria into the aglycone form (free quercetin) for absorption.

item.title: Curcumin
item.description:
What Is Curcumin?

Curcumin is the primary active compound in turmeric (Curcuma longa), a golden spice used for thousands of years in Ayurvedic and Traditional Chinese Medicine. It comprises only 2-8% of turmeric by weight, which is why standardized curcumin extracts are far more potent than turmeric powder alone.

Curcumin is a polyphenol—a class of plant compounds with powerful antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. It’s one of the most researched natural compounds, with over 12,000 published studies demonstrating benefits across numerous health conditions.

item.title: Glucosamine
item.description:
What Is Glucosamine?

Glucosamine is a naturally occurring amino sugar that serves as a fundamental building block for cartilage, tendons, ligaments, and synovial fluid. Your body produces glucosamine to maintain and repair joint tissues, but production declines with age and joint stress.

As a supplement, glucosamine is derived primarily from shellfish shells (chitin) or synthesized in laboratories for shellfish-free options. It provides the raw materials your joints need to rebuild cartilage matrix and maintain healthy synovial fluid viscosity — the lubricant that allows smooth joint movement.

item.title: Omega-3 Fish Oil
item.description:
